name: @mochi/agent
description: Minimal, fast, autonomous coding agent: Rust runtime core with a TypeScript frontend.

scripts.build:rust: cargo build --release --manifest-path native/mochi_core/Cargo.toml && cp --remove-destination native/mochi_core/target/release/mochi-agent native/bin/ && cp --remove-destination native/mochi_core/target/release/libmochi_core.so native/bin/mochi_core.node && cp --remove-destination native/mochi_core/target/release/libmochi_core.so native/bin/
scripts.build:native: mkdir -p native/bin && (cargo build --release --manifest-path native/mochi_core/Cargo.toml && cp --remove-destination native/mochi_core/target/release/mochi-agent native/bin/ && cp --remove-destination native/mochi_core/target/release/libmochi_core.so native/bin/mochi_core.node && cp --remove-destination native/mochi_core/target/release/libmochi_core.so native/bin/ || true) && (rustc -O -o native/bin/fuzzy_rust native/rust/fuzzy.rs || true) && (rustc -O -o native/bin/search_rust native/rust/search.rs || true) && (g++ -O2 -std=c++17 -o native/bin/fuzzy_cpp native/cpp/fuzzy.cpp || true)
